dialog.title: Ask {name} to quote
dialog.description: Choose one of your open tasks. {name} gets a notification and decides whether to send a quote.

prompt.title: Ask {name} to quote on this task?
prompt.description: {name} gets a notification and decides whether to send a quote.

en.toast: {name} has been asked to quote on {task}.

errors.alreadySent: You've already asked {name} about this task.
errors.taskLimit: You've asked 5 workers about this task, the most for one task.
errors.dailyLimit: You've asked 10 workers in the last 24 hours. Try again later.
errors.notAvailable: {name} can't be asked to quote right now.
errors.taskClosed: This task isn't open for quotes any more.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Refresh and try again.

dialog.title: 請 {name} 報價
dialog.description: 請選擇你其中一項開放中的任務。{name} 會收到通知，並自行決定是否報價。

prompt.title: 要請 {name} 就此任務報價嗎？
prompt.description: {name} 會收到通知，並自行決定是否報價。

errors.taskLimit: 你已就此任務邀請了 5 位工作者，已達單一任務的上限。
errors.dailyLimit: 你在過去 24 小時內已邀請了 10 位工作者。請稍後再試。
errors.taskClosed: 此任務已不再接受報價。
errors.generic: 操作未成功。請重新整理後再試。
